title: Count the customers with an email
prompt: Return one row with two columns: customers, the number of customers, and with_email, the number of customers who have an email. The starter counts rows in both columns.
hints: Some customers have no email. Which form of count leaves those rows out?
count(column) counts only the rows where that column is not NULL.
Change the second count to count(email).

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts emails in both columns, so customers is too low.
Counts different ids, which is the same as counting rows.

feedback: The two numbers should differ by the number of customers who have no email.
